title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Stockton University
description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with publicly posted evening availability in Galloway and nearby Atlantic County.

cards.title: Denny’s on East White Horse Pike
cards.subtitle: 242 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Use the location page before heading out; it lists near-continuous service and supports dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway diner with service extending to midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists this Galloway location’s hours as ending at 11:58 PM, 12:59 AM, or operating through midnight depending on the day.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours ending at 11:58 PM, 12:59 AM, or midnight; check the page for the applicable day.

cards.title: Castillo Pizzería Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 80 W Jimmie Leeds Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Plan a pickup order for the posted 11 PM close, and confirm availability directly on the restaurant’s ordering page.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway pizza restaurant posted open until 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Castillo Pizzería Restaurant’s official ordering page lists its Galloway address and hours of 11 AM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 11:00 AM–11:00 PM; verify before travel because hours can change.

cards.title: Hoon King Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 219 E Collins Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Choose pickup or delivery and use the restaurant’s posted schedule; Friday and Saturday service is listed later than weekdays.
cards.short_summary: Chinese takeout in Galloway with 10:30 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoon King’s official site lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 AM–10:30 PM and identifies its Galloway address.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10:30 PM; Monday–Thursday are listed through 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Harbor Diner
cards.subtitle: 613 White Horse Pike, Egg Harbor City
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday option when planning a later meal; the diner’s contact page posts a 10 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby diner with 10 PM Friday and Saturday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Harbor Diner’s official contact page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 7 AM–10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 PM.

cards.title: King Phoenix
cards.subtitle: 103 Washington Ave, Egg Harbor City
cards.notes: Use the online ordering page to confirm the day; Friday and Saturday are posted until 10 PM for pickup planning.
cards.short_summary: Egg Harbor City Chinese restaurant open until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: King Phoenix’s official site lists Friday and Saturday business hours of 11 AM–10 PM at 103 Washington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday close at 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Aroma Indian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 224 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own schedule before leaving; dinner service is posted through 9:30 PM every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: Galloway Indian cuisine with evening service listed through 9:30 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Aroma Indian Cuisine’s official site lists its Galloway dinner hours as ending at 9:30 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner service through 9:30 PM daily, following an afternoon break on most days.

cards.title: The Madison Room
cards.subtitle: 324 S Pitney Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday evening meal, use the posted takeout or dining-room schedule and confirm service before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway dining room with Friday and Saturday service through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madison Room’s official page lists dining-room and takeout hours through 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday dining-room and takeout hours of 11 AM–10 PM.

cards.title: Main Dining Room at Seaview
cards.subtitle: 401 S New York Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Plan around the hotel’s posted dinner hours, especially Friday and Saturday, and confirm seating or reservation requirements directly.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway hotel dining room posted until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Seaview’s official dining page lists Main Dining Room hours through 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hotel page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; other listed days end at 9 PM.

cards.title: The Smithville Inn
cards.subtitle: 1 N New York Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Use the inn’s official site to check the active dinner schedule; its visitor information identifies the historic Smithville location.
cards.short_summary: Historic Smithville dining with later Friday and Saturday evening hours publicly listed.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithville Inn’s official website identifies the restaurant at Historic Smithville; its published dining information lists Friday and Saturday service through 9:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Published dining information lists Friday and Saturday hours through 9:30 PM; confirm the current schedule directly before visiting.

cards.title: Jasmine Desi Asian Grill
cards.subtitle: 310 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Reserve or verify directly before an evening visit; the restaurant’s published schedule extends Friday and Saturday service to 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: Galloway Indian, Thai, and Chinese dining listed until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Jasmine Desi Asian Grill’s official website identifies the Galloway restaurant; its published hours list Friday and Saturday service until 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Published hours list Friday and Saturday service through 10 PM; Monday–Thursday and Sunday are listed through 9:30 PM.
